title.en: EU adopted Regulation 2022/2340 concerning green-tea extracts containing EGCG
title.zh: 欧盟通过涉及含 EGCG 绿茶提取物的法规 2022/2340

summary.en: The Commission adopted an amendment to Annex III of Regulation 1925/2006 on 30 November 2022. This is a dated regulatory milestone, not new 2026 news or a compliance opinion. Review the official text, any amendments and the exact extract/use conditions with a qualified adviser before market entry.
summary.zh: 欧盟委员会于 2022 年 11 月 30 日通过修订法规 1925/2006 附件 III 的法规。这是注明时间的监管历史事件，不是 2026 年新消息或合规意见。进入市场前须与合格顾问核查官方文本、后续修订及具体提取物和使用条件。

reviewScope: official event identity and adoption date only; no market authorization assessment
